title: development-vessel/src/compose-slots.ts reads SLOT_DIR as a module-level const (process.env['COMPOSE_SLOT_DIR'] ?? defau
description: development-vessel/src/compose-slots.ts reads SLOT_DIR as a module-level const (process.env['COMPOSE_SLOT_DIR'] ?? default) captured once at import time, the same defect class fixed today in substrate-gap.ts (workspaceRoot) and in local-tools-vessel's test-exec-slots.ts (caught during its own first draft). Not yet proven to cause a live incident for compose-slots.ts specifically -- its own test suite may not vary COMPOSE_SLOT_DIR per test the way test-exec-slots.test.ts did -- but the same class of silent test-isolation failure (or a future env-var override anywhere in the process never taking effect) is latent. Fix by reading process.env at call time, same as the other two fixes today.
